name: skillcheck
description: Check agent instructions with exact source evidence

commands.title: Skillcheck: Show Diff against Git Baseline

skillcheck.baseline.description: Git baseline used for instruction comparisons.

skillcheck.allowCloudAnalysis.description: Allow semantic editor analysis to transmit original and unsaved instructions to TypeSafe. Repository configuration must also enable semantic analysis. Restart the extension after changing this.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Skillcheck reads repository instructions; enable it only in a trusted workspace.
